A '''Sakiyan customer''' was patronizing the [[Dewback Inn]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] when the [[Human/Legends|Human]] clerk [[Lorn Pavan]] visited the establishment. The [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] had extensive scarring about the [[Hair/Legends|hairless]] head, which led Pavan to suppose the Sakiyan had seen combat before.
